harness.renderer: Chromium 147.0.7727.15 headless via Playwright 1.59.1; WebGL backend ANGLE (Google, Vulkan 1.3.0 (SwiftShader Device (LLVM 10.0.0) (0x0000C0DE)), SwiftShader driver) — software rasterisation, recorded so a grey-on-grey grade can be told apart from a material finding
harness.subjectAlone: staged GLB mesh names only (10 meshes per body, listed per body); no ground-plane mesh in the GLB scene graph; no lamp nodes in a GLB; grade canvas is the isolated capture canvas (#model-vetting-candidate-capture-canvas). The grid floor in the PNGs is the studio capture backdrop, not GLB geometry.
harness.viewport: 4096x4096 browser viewport; tracked PNG IHDR 4096x4096 (rendered, not resampled)

whyEachClauseWasVacuous: (1) a JSON field > 0 certifies the lighting config, not the render. Any edit to grade-lighting.json moves the number without touching a pixel.
(2) four regex matches over finished_figure_grade.py certify the script mentions ambient lighting, not that the render has any.
(3) a Blender --dump-lighting run reports the live Background node strength, which is the same config clause (1) reads, rendered as JSON.
(4) corner luma samples the world background, which is exactly where the key light's failure does not show; the two-tone figure it passed on proves it.
(5) dump-bounds floorZ reads the Blender scene (bmin.z), the same scene whose unparented Icosphere caused the float; HB-01 proved the GLB bytes never contained it.

method: GLB JSON chunk read (12-byte header, uint32LE at offset 12 = JSON length; same frame as HB-00) for materials/meshes/nodes/copyright; glTF-Transform NodeIO scene-graph AABB with node world matrices (probeSceneGraphMeshAabb, the tool's own probe) for height/extent; three.js GLTFLoader scene-graph AABB in Chromium for the in-page half; HB-01 audit for the global-minimum footing; HB-03 report for the live rung (promoted, never chosenRungId); write-shipped-licence-notice.ts --check for the notice (fresh run, all shipped bodies pass). No Blender scene opened on this card.
notEvidenceFor: visual grade verdict (the orchestrator grades the pixels; this card issues none)
notTested: three_quarter views (manual pass covers front_lit + front_structure only; the tool's default GRADE_VIEWS covers both)
